['Infraserv GmbH & Co. H\u00f6chst KG '].company_description: Infraserv GmbH & Co. Höchst KG operates as a site operator, supplying companies with heat and electricity for the production of vital medicines, food additives, high-performance plastics, and crop protection agents. The company also offers digital twin technology to optimize energy use and has completed successful pilot projects in this area.

['KWS Saat SE '].company_description: KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA is a European independent and family-owned company based in Germany that focuses on plant breeding, with activities in about 70 countries. The company is the fourth largest seed producer worldwide based on sales in agricultural crops. Its product range includes seed varieties for sugar beet, corn, cereals, oil and protein plants, sorghum, catch crops, and vegetables. The company's original headquarters were in Klein Wanzleben, an East German town located near the city of Magdeburg. KWS has breeding and distribution activities in more than 70 countries and has been listed on the SDAX list of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since June 2006.
